title: Gestalt Perceptual Analysis in Everyday Design
description: Examine digital interfaces and graphic logos to identify how Gestalt grouping laws direct human visual attention.
problemStatement:
Select two well-known company logos or mobile app user interfaces (e.g., the FedEx logo, the WWF panda, or a music streaming app dashboard).

### Requirements:
1. Identify at least three distinct Gestalt principles utilized in each design (e.g., Figure-Ground segregation, Closure, Proximity, Similarity, Continuity).
2. Explain how the graphic designer manipulated contrast and spacing to compel the viewer's brain to assemble a unified 'whole' (Gestalt).
3. Detail how poor Gestalt organization can cause user confusion and perceptual errors.
hints: Hint 1: Look for clever uses of negative space as 'ground' creating an unexpected 'figure'.
Hint 2: Elements placed close together are instinctively interpreted as belonging to the same category.
